title: Balaam Blesses Israel

questions.question: When Balaam saw that it pleased the Lord to bless Israel, what did he NOT do this time?
options: He did not go, as at other times, to look for omens
questions.correctAnswer: He did not go, as at other times, to look for omens
questions.explanation: Numbers 24:1 (ESV): "He did not go, as at other times, to look for omens, but set his face toward the wilderness."

questions.question: What came upon Balaam when he lifted up his eyes and saw Israel camping?
questions.explanation: Numbers 24:2 (ESV): "And the Spirit of God came upon him."

questions.question: How did Balaam describe Israel's tents?
options: How lovely are your tents, O Jacob!
questions.correctAnswer: How lovely are your tents, O Jacob!
questions.explanation: Numbers 24:5 (ESV): "How lovely are your tents, O Jacob, your encampments, O Israel!"

questions.question: How did Balak react to the third blessing?
options: His anger was kindled, he struck his hands together, and told Balaam to flee
questions.correctAnswer: His anger was kindled, he struck his hands together, and told Balaam to flee
questions.explanation: Numbers 24:10 (ESV): "And Balak's anger was kindled... and he struck his hands together... Flee to your place!"

questions.question: Balaam prophesied: "A star shall come out of Jacob, and a ... shall rise out of Israel."
questions.explanation: Numbers 24:17 (ESV): "A star shall come out of Jacob, and a scepter shall rise out of Israel."

questions.question: What did Balaam say about the man whose eye is opened?
options: He hears the words of God and sees the vision of the Almighty
questions.correctAnswer: He hears the words of God and sees the vision of the Almighty
questions.explanation: Numbers 24:3-4 (ESV): "The oracle of the man whose eye is opened... who sees the vision of the Almighty..."

questions.question: Water shall flow from his buckets, and his seed shall be in...? (describing Israel)
questions.explanation: Numbers 24:7 (ESV): "Water shall flow from his buckets, and his seed shall be in many waters."

questions.question: His king shall be higher than whom?
questions.explanation: Numbers 24:7 (ESV): "His king shall be higher than Agag, and his kingdom shall be exalted."

questions.question: Who crouches as a lion?
questions.explanation: Numbers 24:9 (ESV): "He crouched, he lay down as a lion and as a lioness; who will rouse him up?"

questions.question: Balaam said, "I see him, but not now; I behold him, but...?"
questions.explanation: Numbers 24:17 (ESV): "I see him, but not now; I behold him, but not near."

questions.question: Whom shall the star/scepter crush?
questions.explanation: Numbers 24:17 (ESV): "It shall crush the forehead of Moab and break down all the sons of Sheth."

questions.question: What did Balaam say about Amalek?
options: Amalek was the first of the nations, but his end is destruction
questions.correctAnswer: Amalek was the first of the nations, but his end is destruction
questions.explanation: Numbers 24:20 (ESV): "Amalek was the first of the nations, but his end is utter destruction."

questions.question: What did he say about Kenite?
options: Enduring is your dwelling place... nevertheless Kain shall be burned
questions.correctAnswer: Enduring is your dwelling place... nevertheless Kain shall be burned
questions.explanation: Numbers 24:21-22 (ESV): "...your nest is set in the rock. Nevertheless, Kain shall be burned..."

questions.question: Who will dispossess Edom and Seir?
questions.explanation: Numbers 24:18 (ESV): "Edom shall be dispossessed; Seir also... Israel is doing valiantly."

questions.question: Where did Balaam look over to see the Kenite?
questions.explanation: Context of the third oracle location (Peor) where he looks out.

key_verse_text: I see him, but not now; I behold him, but not near: a star shall come out of Jacob, and a scepter shall rise out of Israel; it shall crush the forehead of Moab...
